_meta.title: The Master Translation Grid
_meta.note: Concept x Lens. Type collapsed to universal. The scientific lens is bound by The_Verified_Ground_Floor.md.

core_systems.name: The Defense
core_systems.experience: Reacting to protect ourselves from perceived harm, judgment, or the threat of being misunderstood.
core_systems.scientific: Sympathetic arousal and threat response; allostatic load as the cumulative cost of staying braced. [ESTABLISHED]

core_systems.name: The Core Truth
core_systems.experience: Feeling grounded, clear, and unbothered by external chaos - the baseline that exists before any performance.
core_systems.scientific: Homeostasis; a rest-and-restore baseline indexed by vagal tone (heart-rate variability), which reliably tracks self-regulation. [ESTABLISHED - cite HRV research directly, not polyvagal]

core_systems.name: Sensing Reality
core_systems.experience: Reading a room, feeling a gut instinct about a situation, knowing something before the mind names it.
core_systems.scientific: Interoception - the body reading its own internal signals - plus the threat response firing from ~74ms, before conscious appraisal catches up. [ESTABLISHED]

core_systems.name: The Mental Loop
core_systems.experience: Overthinking, assuming the worst, living inside our heads, running scripts instead of being present.
core_systems.scientific: Default Mode Network activity in rumination - the brain simulating futures instead of reading the room. [ESTABLISHED for DMN; the predictive-processing frame is MODEL]

core_systems.name: The False Narrative
core_systems.experience: Anticipating interactions, assuming the worst, living inside a script written by past fear rather than present reality.
core_systems.spiritual: The Small Reality: projecting past fears onto the present to maintain an illusion of control.
core_systems.scientific: Prediction error: a leading account holds the brain runs on prediction and updates against error, so it guesses the present from the past instead of reading current data. [MODEL - dominant framework, not settled mechanism]
core_systems.product: System Data Correction: showing the gap between the fear and the actual reality.

core_systems.name: The Core Motivation
core_systems.experience: The fundamental, nervous-system-level condition a person needs in order to not feel like they are dying.
core_systems.spiritual: The Core Drive - the specific condition (truth, stability, freedom, peace) required before a person will pull their Wall down.
core_systems.scientific: The specific environmental condition a person's threat system requires before it will stand down. [MODEL - we model this as type-specific; no research links types to neurochemical profiles]
core_systems.product: The User Blueprint: the individualized map of each person's triggers and safety requirements.

core_systems.name: The Growth Process
core_systems.experience: Facing our pain, stopping the pattern that no longer serves us, learning to reorganize how we meet reality.
core_systems.scientific: Neuroplasticity - the nervous system genuinely rewiring toward new patterns with repetition. [ESTABLISHED]

core_systems.name: The Healing
core_systems.experience: The long-term result of doing this work daily - the cumulative integration over time.
core_systems.spiritual: The Arc of Return: shedding the identity of the tool and coming back to the human being.
core_systems.scientific: Consolidated change: repeated regulation under load builds a faster, more reliable return - measurable as recovery time. [ESTABLISHED]

core_systems.name: Shared Connection
core_systems.experience: Two people feeling safe, seen, and unarmored with each other - truth existing without performance.
core_systems.scientific: Each person's own threat response standing down in the other's presence, with behavioral coordination between them (modestly linked to feeling bonded). Not two systems merging - two systems each finding their own ground, together. [ESTABLISHED for the modest behavioral link; 'nervous systems syncing' and limbic resonance are NOT established]

relational_mechanics.name: The Flinch
relational_mechanics.experience: The instant, hot, physical reaction to feeling misunderstood or attacked - specifically when someone else is sharing their feelings.
relational_mechanics.spiritual: The Wall Goes Up - the armor deploying to protect the Small Reality.
relational_mechanics.scientific: The threat response fires before conscious appraisal catches up, and prefrontal regulation weakens under it. A head start, not a hijack. [ESTABLISHED]
relational_mechanics.product: The Catch: the exact vulnerability the system detects and intercepts.

relational_mechanics.name: The Anchor
relational_mechanics.experience: The physical act of stopping the internal spiral before reacting - finding your ground and registering that you are not actually under attack.
relational_mechanics.spiritual: Sovereignty / Truth: finding your ground, and the realization that you are actually safe.
relational_mechanics.scientific: Slow breathing and posture raise vagal tone, bringing prefrontal regulation back online. [ESTABLISHED]
relational_mechanics.product: The Tool: the physical protocol where the muscle memory for the pause gets built.

relational_mechanics.name: The Shift
relational_mechanics.experience: The moment of stopping the defense and actively trying to understand the other person's reality.
relational_mechanics.spiritual: Curiosity / Care: the intentional choice to drop the ego and step into truth.
relational_mechanics.scientific: Prefrontal regulation turns the threat signal down; it does not switch it off. The alarm quiets, it doesn't vanish. Curiosity and defense are not mutually exclusive - engaging regulation dampens the threat response. [ESTABLISHED]
relational_mechanics.product: The Toggle: the action that moves the system from defense toward curiosity.

relational_mechanics.name: The Encounter
relational_mechanics.experience: Navigating a hard, honest conversation without armor on either side.
relational_mechanics.spiritual: Standing in the Big Reality - where truth exists without performance.
relational_mechanics.scientific: Both threat systems standing down at once, each person holding their own ground while coordinating with the other. Two operators, both awake. [ESTABLISHED for the modest coordination link; syncing/fusion is NOT established]
relational_mechanics.product: The Lab: the live, unscripted relational environment that tests the whole system.
